query: For short-answer open-domain QA, how does the correctness criterion reported by RAG differ from the criterion used by Self-RAG for PopQA and TriviaQA?

drafts: RAG在开放域问答上报告Exact Match (EM)分数作为正确性准则[26]。Self-RAG对PopQA和TriviaQA则依据金标准答案是否包含在模型生成内容中来评测，而不严格要求精确匹配[2]。因此二者差异在于：RAG采用精确匹配，Self-RAG采用答案包含式判定[2][26]。

cited_sources.text: For PopQA, we use the long-tail subset, consisting of 1,399 rare entity queries whose monthly Wikipedia page views are less than 100. As the TriviaQA-unfiltered (open) test set is not publicly available, we follow prior work’s validation and test split (Min et al., 2019; Guu et al., 2020), using 11,313 test queries for evaluation. We evaluate performance based on whether gold answers are included in the model generations instead of strictly requiring exact matching, following Mallen et al.
We use the same train/dev/test splits as prior work [31, 26] and report Exact Match (EM) scores. For TQA, to compare with T5 [52], we also evaluate on the TQA Wiki test set.
